name: patchbay-go
description: Cloudflare Pages worker that wraps custom URL schemes (obsidian://, x-apple-reminderkit://, calshow:, ...) in https:// links so chat apps recognize them as tappable. Optional end-to-end encrypted secret handoff.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp src/worker.js dist/_worker.js && cp website/index.html dist/index.html
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name patchbay-go --branch main
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
